name: JW Marriott Hotel Rio de Janeiro
positioning: Beachfront hotel on Avenida Atlantica in Copacabana, with ocean-view rooms, beach service and a rooftop fitness center
best_for: Travelers who want to stay right in front of Copacabana Beach
Guests who want an Executive Lounge facing the beach

facts.text: The hotel is located in front of the beach and near main business districts and airports.
Ocean-view rooms feature luxury bedding and upscale amenities.
The outdoor pool is heated, with a lifeguard on duty and towels provided.
SPA by JW offers experiences designed around four benefits: calm, invigorate, satisfy and renew.
The Carioca is the all-day-dining restaurant, with local cuisine and international favorites, located on the Mezzanine overlooking Copacabana beach.
The Moonlounge Rooftop Bar serves international street food prepared with fresh and local ingredients.
The hotel suggests visiting Christ the Redeemer, Copacabana Beach, Tijuca Forest and Sugarloaf Mountain.
The hotel is a smoke-free property.

highlights.text: The hotel sits on Avenida Atlantica in Copacabana, in front of the beach.
The hotel offers beach service with umbrellas and sun loungers.
The fitness center is on the rooftop, overlooking Copacabana Beach.
The JW Marriott Executive Lounge is on the 9th floor facing Copacabana beach, with daily Happy Hour snacks and beverages.
Suites have separate living spaces and deluxe sleeping areas.

considerations.text: Rooms do not permit rollaway beds.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
